title: First Alert speech-to-text extraction
description: Materialize First Alert WAV recordings as corpus items and run Biblicus text extraction. Definition of Done: WAVs are imported, catalog counts are verified, extraction is attempted with an available STT backend, and outcomes are recorded.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: First Alert STT extraction is complete. WAVs were materialized, MP3 extraction-ready corpus was prepared, Deepgram key was configured locally, and Deepgram extraction completed with 1999/2000 items extracted.
